decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to cheat large creatures onto the battlefield quickly by using cards like Show and Tell, Through the Breach, and Sneak Attack. These creatures, such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand, are high-impact threats that can quickly end the game if not dealt with. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere to disrupt the opponent's game plan while ramping into powerful plays with mana acceleration like Simian Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and efficient combos.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently assemble and resolve the Doomsday combo, with backup protection provided by counterspells and disruption. Baleful Strix and Teferi, Time Raveler help with card draw and control, while Thassa's Oracle serves as the win condition. The deck also includes various cantrips and tutors to help find key pieces of the combo. The mana base is optimized for the deck's colors and includes fetch lands for consistency. This deck aims to win the game in a single turn through a well-executed Doomsday pile.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, along with versatile options like Ponder and Brainstorm. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Endurance provides additional threats while also disrupting the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support a variety of colors and maximize flexibility, with key lands like Karakas and Mystic Sanctuary adding extra utility. Overall, the deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and dictate the pace of the game through strong, interactive spells.

This deck focuses on casting cheap, powerful creatures like Hollow One and Vengevine quickly using cards that allow for quick discard and self-mill, such as Careful Study and Faithless Looting. The goal is to fill the graveyard with creatures to bring back Vengevine and utilize the madness mechanic to cast cards for cheaper costs. Additionally, Lion's Eye Diamond is used for explosive mana generation. Ox of Agonas provides card advantage and a way to refill the hand. The deck aims to have a fast start and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through disruption and card advantage. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Narset to limit the opponent's options, while also leveraging cards like Hullbreacher to generate additional advantage. The deck also includes a suite of counter spells and removal to control the board, with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. The goal is to outvalue the opponent through resource denial and efficient card draw, ultimately leading to victory through superior control of the game.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy utilizing Goblin creatures. The goal is to quickly build a board presence with cards like Goblin Lackey and Mogg War Marshal, while also boosting the strength of the Goblins with cards like Goblin Chieftain and Goblin Warchief. Cards like Muxus, Goblin Grandee provide immense value by allowing you to put multiple Goblins into play at once. The deck also includes utility cards like Munitions Expert and Sling-Gang Lieutenant to help control the battlefield and deal additional damage.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful enchantments and planeswalkers. The key strategy is to stall the opponent's actions by applying curses and limiting their options with cards like Curse of Exhaustion and Curse of Death's Hold. The deck also utilizes powerful spells like Omniscience and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to gain control of the game. It includes a mix of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy, alongside ramping effects like Veteran Explorer and Crop Rotation. The deck aims to gain an advantage through its ability to search for specific cards using cards like Living Wish and Academy Rector.

The main idea of this deck is to efficiently combo off with Mystic Forge and various artifact mana accelerators such as Mox Opal and Grim Monolith. This allows the player to churn through their deck and potentially generate infinite mana through Paradox Engine. Karn, the Great Creator serves as a powerful utility card to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while cards like Defense Grid and Hope of Ghirapur help protect the combo. The land base is optimized for fast mana production with City of Traitors and Ancient Tomb.

The main concept of this deck is to use the "Show and Tell" combo to cheat powerful creatures into play, such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand. This is achieved by using cards like Force of Will and Brainstorm to protect and set up the combo, while also utilizing cards like Sneak Attack and Lotus Petal to facilitate the cheat. The deck also includes additional control elements like Brazen Borrower, Intuition, and counter spells like Force of Will. The mana base consists of lands that produce colorless and red mana, with fetch lands like Misty Rainforest and Scalding Tarn to provide the necessary card selection.

The deck focuses on assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill your opponent's library and win the game. It also utilizes artifact synergy with cards like Goblin Engineer and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to recur important pieces and generate value. Control elements such as Force of Will and Pyroblast help protect your combo and disrupt your opponent's strategies. The deck aims to quickly set up its combo while managing opposing threats with a mix of card advantage, disruption, and efficient artifact interactions.

This deck focuses on assembling the Bomberman combo of Auriok Salvagers and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate infinite mana. Karn, the Great Creator is used to tutor for key pieces and shut down opposing strategies. The deck also includes disruptive elements such as Chalice of the Void and Esper Sentinel to control the game and protect the combo. The mana base includes powerful lands like Ancient Tomb and Urza's Saga to support the combo and ensure a smooth gameplay experience.

The deck revolves around utilizing artifacts to quickly generate advantage and pressure opponents. By combining aggressive creatures like Sai, Master Thopterist and Emry, Lurker of the Loch with powerful artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Urza's Bauble, the deck can disrupt opponents while also maintaining a strong board presence. Karn, the Great Creator allows for additional versatility and disruption, while cards like Lotus Petal and Mox Opal provide ramp and acceleration. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with a combination of artifacts and creature threats while controlling the game with disruptive spells like Force of Will.

This deck focuses on playing powerful red aggressive creatures such as Bonecrusher Giant, Goblin Rabblemaster, and Legion Warboss while disrupting opponents with cards like Chalice of the Void, Trinisphere, Blood Moon, and Shatterskull Smashing. The goal is to quickly establish board control and pressure opponents with hasty creatures, backed up by hand disruption and land destruction to disrupt their game plan. The deck aims to close out games quickly by overwhelming opponents with a combination of aggression and disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently play out creatures with cheaper casting costs and take advantage of the combo potential of Aluren, which allows players to cast creatures with converted mana cost 3 or less for free. By combining cards like Ice-Fang Coatl, Uro, and Acererak the Archlich with Aluren, players can generate value and set up game-winning plays. Additionally, the deck includes disruption through cards like Force of Will and Cabal Therapy to control the board and protect the combo. The mana base is designed to support the deck's multicolor requirements while also enabling efficient creature searches and plays.

This Death & Taxes deck focuses on using disruptive creatures and removal spells to control the opponent's board while applying pressure with efficient threats. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth to slow down the opponent, along with powerful equipment like Sword of Fire and Ice and Umezawa's Jitte to enhance their creatures, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and continually apply pressure until victory is achieved. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in longer games.

This deck focuses on quickly generating mana through Cloudpost and Glimmerpost to ramp into powerful creatures and artifacts. The main strategy is to use Karn, the Great Creator's ability to search for and activate artifacts like Helm of Obedience and Manifold Key to eliminate opponents' resources or create game-ending combinations. Additionally, Thought-Knot Seer and Leyline of the Void disrupt opponents' strategies by exiling their cards. Trinisphere and Pithing Needle further disrupt opponents' plays, while Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon provide additional threats and removal options. The deck also includes utility lands like Eye of Ugin and Karakas for additional advantage.
